listen_addr.description: IP address the server listens on (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or 127.0.0.1 for localhost only).

listen_port.description: TCP port for incoming DSMI over WLAN connections (standard port is 5004).

midi_device_path.description: Path to the Linux MIDI device node (e.g., /dev/midiC0D0) to expose over the network.

keepalive_enabled.description: Enable TCP keepalive packets to detect broken client connections.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity after which a client connection is closed.

log_file_path.description: Path to a file for logging output; leave empty to use syslog.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for connections (requires valid certificate and key).

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format).

mdns_hostname.description: mDNS hostname to advertise (e.g., dsmidiwifi.local); leave blank to disable mDNS.

acl_entries.description: List of allowed networks (IP/CIDR) — only clients from these networks may connect. Leave empty to allow all.
